title: SMILE: A Composite Lexical-Semantic Metric for Question-Answering Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative case studies demonstrating that LLM-as-judge evaluators (like GPT-4o) can be tricked into assigning high scores to factually incorrect responses if they contain concrete artifacts, such as generated tables.

Comparing evaluation metrics against original ground-truth references versus synthetic canonicalized references to show that traditional embedding and n-gram metrics over-score verbose or contradictory responses due to high surface-level text overlap.
